entities.summary: Olivier Sarr is a French professional basketball player for the Cleveland Cavaliers of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Cleveland Charge of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Wake Forest Demon Deacons and Kentucky Wildcats. He is the older brother of basketball player Alex Sarr.
